author: Phjilip
body:
Hey guys!
I am Philip or Phil and problably you know me from the server!
I am looking for a good team!
I hope some leaders of some teams have some interests :) for me.
I hope on a team with +16 players :)

IMPORTANT: Atm I am in Italy for 3 weeks!
My information:
  • Age: 13
  • IGN: Phxlip_
  • KD: 0.87 
  • Timezone: GMT + 1:00
  • Position: Rush or defence  (I can play skybridge and midfield for the carry if is needed!)
  • Bridging: Ninja, breezily, stairs and normal 
  • Communication: Skype : Philhismc and Teamspeak
  • Have been in 3 teams and subbed many times for other teams and played many megascrims.
